title: DocEditorConfig
description: The `config` property of <doc-editor> (05 section 8.1; PRO-081). The TypeScript type is DocEditorConfig in src/config.ts. Keys the component does not know are ignored (PRO-005), and a value of the wrong type leaves the default in place. The names are working placeholders.

styleNonce.description: Nonce for the <style> element the component creates when constructable stylesheets fail (02 section 3). Absent by default; an empty string counts as absent.

graceMs.description: Grace period before a disconnected editor destroys itself, in milliseconds (02 section 2.1). Default 30,000. A negative or non-finite value is ignored.

pdfViewerUrl.description: URL of the PDF viewer's page (FE-071). Default: viewer/pdf-viewer.html next to the module. Absent by default; an empty string counts as absent.

katexFontsUrl.description: The directory, ending in a slash, that the host serves KaTeX's .woff2 files from (FE-069). The editor registers them under hash aliases. Absent by default: no KaTeX font is registered; an empty string counts as absent.

selectionShim.description: Where the shadow root's getSelection comes from (02 section 8; spike S1 section 4.7). instance defines it on the editor's own root; library lets ProseMirror patch ShadowRoot.prototype.

footnoteModel.description: Experimental, for spike evidence only: the footnote content model (03 section 13; CDM-001). paragraph is the CDM's footnote content; inline is the spike's option A.

deferRemoteWhileComposing.description: Experimental, for spike evidence only: defer remote commits while the user composes text (input method).

forceStyleFallback.description: Experimental, for spike evidence only: use the nonce <style> element even where constructable stylesheets work.

features.description: Feature switches (PRO-081; owner decision 89). Each group is on unless its key is false: comments (comments and suggestions), export (export and print), history, and assistant (assistant and proofing). A group that is off has no controls when the editor loads; it is not a permission, and the server still decides what a caller may do. Any other value, or a key that is not a group, is ignored.

comments.description: Comments and suggestions: the comments and review panes and commands, the suggestion markup views and the suggesting mode.

export.description: Export and print: the export dialog and command, the print command and the PDF pane.

history.description: History: the history and catch-up panes and naming a version.

assistant.description: Assistant and proofing: the assistant pane, the proofing commands and the findings.

pageGuides.description: Draws page guides in the web view where the last completed export's layout.json started a page (02 section 7; FE-068). Off by default; a guide is exact only at block starts and drifts between compiles.
